elements.evidence: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence

elements.evidence: MSL shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement
errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000
cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000

reasons: All five preferred coverage lines (CGL 1M/2M, E&O 2M, cyber 5M conditioned on data processing, workers' comp, certificates on request) appear expressly in the inserted Section 16.22, so the locked preferred level is complete.
The insertion is a concise stand-alone covenant for a clause that was wholly absent from the Agreement, which is the minimal available means; no existing sentence was rewritten or deleted.

The 'for one (1) year thereafter' tail and the non-limitation sentence go marginally beyond the stated position, but the tail is a short customer-favourable add-on and the non-limitation sentence prevents conflict with the existing consigned-Products and tooling insurance obligations, so neither is a material over-reach.
No undefined terms, contradictions or dangling mechanics introduced; the surrounding consigned-inventory and tooling provisions remain fully effective.
